text: Route prefix: /billing. Manages patient financial accounts: invoices, billing line items, payments, discounts, fund sources, insurance providers, and document printing (invoice, payment receipt, statement of account). Core component: BillingCrud (Livewire, massive with 2109 lines of code).

items: id - Primary key.
tenant_id - FK to hospitals.id.

invoice_code - Code: 'INV-' + 5-digit sequence (e.g. INV-00001). Generated by generateInvoiceCode($tid): finds last BillingInvoice for tenant, parses numeric after 'INV-', increments, pads to 5 digits. 'INV-00001' if no existing invoice.
patient_id - FK to patients.id. The patient being billed.
bill_date - Date. Invoice date. Defaults to today (Y-m-d).
due_date - Date. Payment due date.
subtotal_services - Float. Sum of service charges (lab + pharmacy + CSR + radiology + procedure + manual charges).
discount_type - String: 'percentage' or 'fixed' (nullable).
discount_value - Float (nullable). The discount percentage or fixed amount.
discount_amount - Float. Computed discount amount.
total_amount - Float. Subtotal - discount + any other adjustments.
paid_amount - Float. Total payments received against this invoice.
balance - Float. Total - paid_amount. If <=0, status = 'Paid'.
status - Invoice status: Unpaid, Partial, Paid, Overpaid, Cancelled, Write-Off, Doubtful, Provision, Suspense.
payment_terms - String (nullable). e.g. 'Cash', 'Installment', 'PhilHealth', 'HMO', 'Insurance'.
remarks - Text (nullable).
created_by / created_date - Audit columns.
updated_by / updated_date - Audit columns.
history - Soft delete flag (1=active).
is_active - Active flag.
id - Primary key.
tenant_id - FK to hospitals.id.
billing_invoice_id - FK to billing_invoices.id.
patient_id - FK to patients.id.
line_item_code - Line item code (e.g. LI-00001).
line_type - String: 'Service' (lab/pharmacy/CSR/radiology/procedure order charges), 'Manual Charge' (manual charge entries), 'Fund Source Disbursement' (fund source payment allocations).
description - String. Description of the charge.
quantity - Float (default 1).
unit_price - Float. Price per unit.
total_amount - Float. Quantity x unit_price (or just unit_price for services).
source_type - String (nullable). The source of this line item: 'LabRequest', 'PharmacyRequest', 'CsrRequest', 'RadiologyRequest', 'ProcedureRequest', 'ManualCharge', 'FundSource'.
source_id - FK (nullable). ID of the source record (e.g. lab_request_id, pharmacy_request_id, etc.).
is_billed - Boolean. Whether this line item has been billed to an invoice.
billed_invoice_id - FK (nullable). The invoice this line item was billed to.
created_by / created_date - Audit columns.
updated_by / updated_date - Audit columns.
history - Soft delete flag (1=active).
is_active - Active flag.
id - Primary key.
tenant_id - FK to hospitals.id.
payment_code - Code: 'PAY-' + 5-digit sequence.
patient_id - FK to patients.id.
invoice_id - FK to billing_invoices.id (nullable - can be a direct payment not linked to a specific invoice).
payment_date - Date. Date payment was received.
payment_amount - Float.
payment_method - String: Cash, Check, Credit Card, Debit Card, PhilHealth, HMO/Insurance, Bank Transfer, etc.
reference_no - String (nullable). Check number, transaction reference, etc.
payment_by - String. Name of person who paid (patient, guarantor, HMO, etc.).
receipt_no - String (nullable). Generated receipt number.
payment_notes - Text (nullable).
received_by - FK to users/HCPs (nullable).
created_by / created_date - Audit columns.
updated_by / updated_date - Audit columns.
history - Soft delete flag (1=active).
is_active - Active flag.

text: The BillingCrud Livewire is a large component (2109 lines) that serves as the billing dashboard, invoice creation interface, patient account ledger, and payment recording interface - all in one view with tabs.

items: Shows billing summary: total outstanding balance, total paid this period, total new invoices this period, aging analysis (current, 1-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, >90 days).
Can be filtered by date range, payment status, patient.
Quick summary cards for at-a-glance financial position.
Patient search: autocomplete search by name, patient_code, PhilHealth number.
Select patient to load their account.
When patient selected: unbilled_services loads (requests with status that can be billed), staging_manual_charges loads (pending manual charges for this patient).

The unbilled_services are the line items available to bill: LabRequest items with charge_amount, PharmacyRequest items, CSRRequest items, RadiologyRequest items, ProcedureRequest items, plus any manual charges.
Select patient from search.
Select which unbilled services to include (selectedServiceItems array - multiple selection from unbilled_services).
Optionally add manual charges (see 12.6) - these appear in staging_manual_charges.
Set invoice date (bill_date, default today), due date.
Set payment terms if applicable.
Discount: see 12.5 for discount logic.
Click Save Invoice.

saveInvoice() creates the BillingInvoice with generated invoice_code, computes subtotal_services (sum of selected line items total_amount + manual charges), applies any entered discount (though on save, the discount is applied via saveInvoiceDiscount separately), sets status based on paid_amount (initially 0, so status = 'Unpaid').
Creates BillingLineItems for each billed service/charge with line_type, description, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, source_type/source_id linking back to the original request/charge.
Marks source items as is_billed=true (prevents double-billing).
The invoice is now created and appears in the invoices list.

text: When viewing a patient's account (viewAccount), the BillingCrud shows:

items: All invoices for the patient (billed and unbilled charges).
All payments made by the patient.
Running balance: total charges - total payments.
Current status: whether the patient has outstanding balance.
Invoice list with: invoice_code, bill_date, due_date, subtotal, discount, total, paid, balance, status.
Payment list with: payment_code, payment_date, amount, method, reference_no, receipt_no.
The ledger is the patient's complete financial history.
Select patient.
Select invoice(s) to apply payment to (can be multiple invoices - payment allocated across invoices).
Enter payment amount.
Select payment method: Cash, Check, Credit Card, Debit Card, PhilHealth, HMO/Insurance, Bank Transfer.
Enter reference number (check number, transaction ref, etc.) if applicable.
Enter payment_by name.
Click Save Payment.
savePayment() creates BillingPayment with generated payment_code, payment_date, payment_amount, payment_method, reference_no, payment_by, and links to invoice(s) (billing_invoice_id).
Updates the invoice(s) paid_amount and balance. Recomputes status (Unpaid/Partial/Paid/Overpaid).
If payment exceeds the invoice balance, the overpaid amount remains as credit on the patient account for future invoices.
A payment receipt PDF (see 12.7) can be generated.

text: Applied to a specific invoice after creation. From BillingCrud source code:

items: detail_discount_type: 'percentage' or 'fixed'.
detail_discount_value: percentage (0-100) or fixed amount.
computeDetailDiscount(): Computes discount_amount = round(total_amount * discount_value / 100, 2) for percentage, OR min(discount_value, total_amount) for fixed.

saveInvoiceDiscount(): Updates the invoice with discount_type, discount_value, discount_amount, recomputes balance = total_amount - discount_amount - paid_amount, recomputes status (Paid if balance <=0, Partial if paid_amount > 0, else Unpaid). If balance < 0, sets to 0 (overpayment handled by patient account credit logic).
Flashes 'Discount saved.'

text: Applied during invoice creation to the selected services:

items: discount_type: 'percentage' or 'fixed'.
discount_value: percentage or fixed amount.

computeDiscount(): Computes on the selected services total (serviceTotal = sum of selectedServiceItems total_amount). For percentage: discount_amount = round(serviceTotal * discount_value / 100, 2). For fixed: discount_amount = min(discount_value, serviceTotal).
This discount is applied at invoice creation time when saveInvoice is called.
manualTotal: sum of staging manual charges (total_price). Combined serviceTotal + manualTotal = total for discount computation.
Percentage discount: % off the total. Example: 10% discount on a 5000 invoice = 500 discount, total becomes 4500.
Fixed discount: flat amount off. Example: 500 fixed discount on a 5000 invoice = 500 off, total becomes 4500. Capped at the total (cannot discount below zero).
PhilHealth discount: handled through PhilHealth claims (separate module), not this discount field.
HMO/Insurance discount: handled through the insurance provider and fund source mechanisms.

text: Manual charges are ad-hoc charges added by billing staff that don't come from a lab/pharmacy/CSR/radiology/procedure request. From BillingCrud staging mechanism:

items: Manual charges are staged (temporary, not yet saved to DB) in stagingManualCharges() - a session-managed collection keyed by patient_id.
Add manual charge: description, quantity, unit_price, total_amount (computed).
Manual charges appear in staging_manual_charges and are visible in the invoice creation UI alongside unbilled services.
When creating an invoice, manual charges can be included (selected) along with service charges.
On saveInvoice: manual charges become BillingLineItems with line_type='Manual Charge', source_type='ManualCharge', and are cleared from staging.
Manual charges can also be made persistent via the billing manual-charges management interface (if the module exists) - standing charges that can be re-used.

billing.invoice.print ({invoice}) - Prints the invoice PDF. Shows: invoice header (invoice_code, patient name, address, bill_date, due_date, status), billing line items table (description, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, source reference), subtotal services, discount (type, value, amount), total amount, paid amount, balance, payment terms, remarks. The official invoice document.

billing.payment-receipt ({payment}) - Prints payment receipt PDF. Shows: receipt header (receipt_no, patient name, payment_date, payment amount, payment method, reference_no), payment allocation (which invoices/payments it was applied to), remaining balance, received by, payment notes.

billing.statement ({patientId}) - Prints patient statement of account PDF. Shows: patient name and address, statement period, all invoices (invoice_code, bill_date, due_date, total, paid, balance), all payments (payment_code, date, amount, method), running balance. The patient's account statement - used for billing statements, reminders, and collection.

text: Route: billing.fund-sources (permission: billing.manage). Fund sources for payment: Cash, PhilHealth, HMO/Insurance, Government Assistance (IAC-CTB, RA 11223 PhilHealth Konsulta, TUPAD, etc.), Charity/Donor Fund, Discounts. Each fund source has: id, name, code, description, account_number (for insurance/HMO reference), is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns. Fund sources are used to categorize payments and allocate them to patient accounts.

Route: billing.insurance-providers (permission: billing.manage). Insurance/HMO providers: Maxicare, Intellicare, Carillion, Medicare, Avega, etc. Fields: id, provider_name, provider_code, contact_person, contact_phone, contact_email, address, effective_date, status (Active/Inactive/Expired), is_hmo (boolean - HMO vs regular insurance), is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns. Insurance providers are linked to patient accounts (patient insurance coverage) and used for insurance claims processing.

Patients can have insurance coverage recorded: insurance_provider_id (FK), policy_number, coverage_type, coverage_amount, coverage_start_date, coverage_end_date, is_active. Used when billing insurance claims - the patient's coverage determines what can be claimed and the reimbursement process.
